supersedes: renal-spatial-v03-20260926 (sealed, untouched). v0.3's competitor columns were not within-patient centred while the response was, so the competitor did not transfer across patients (held-out R2 down to -1.14) and its five 'internal' leads carry no held-out information once the competitor is centred (gain <= 0.003). v0.3 also counted proposed folds, not passing folds, toward recurrence. v0.4 fixes both in the forward path and adopts the .claude/ideas.md design: protected measurement bank, residual hypothesis generator, A-F explanation levels.

release.name: measurement-bank-v1 + residual_generator-v1 + standardised inner-CV competitor (frozen configuration)
release.evidence_note: No representation checkpoint. Deep learning enters only as (a) frozen measurement views and (b) the target-conditioned residual hypothesis generator, which nominates hypotheses that are re-fit from scratch on held-out patients.

discovery.candidate_budget_meaning: frozen candidates per relationship family entering the ledger at 'proposed' after the fold sweep; raw per-target proposals are internal search and recorded with their cost
discovery.outer_split: five grouped patient folds over the 24 HEST ccRCC patients (1 sample = 1 patient), deterministic shuffle with fold_seed; each fold in turn is D_R, the other four are D_P; HVG selection, z-score statistics, PCA of image embeddings and program ranking are fit on D_P only

targets.definition_rule: every response is response-free defined, within-patient centred, and never derived from a gene set under test

morphology.morph_pc1: H-optimus per-spot embedding PC 1, PCA fit on D_P, patient-residualised
morphology.cv_count: CellViT nuclei assigned to the spot (nearest-spot assignment, radius = spot_diameter_fullres / 2), log1p
morphology.cv_area: mean nuclear polygon area of the spot's nuclei
morphology.cv_frac_Neoplastic: fraction of the spot's nuclei in CellViT class Neoplastic

spatial_organisation.nbr_mp1..nbr_mp8: neighbour-mean (k=6, within sample) of the 8 Gavish malignant metaprogram scores with the highest within-patient Moran's I on D_P; program identities recorded per fold in the receipt

discovery.candidate_variables: the D_P-selected 300 highest-variance genes (log-CPM, patient fixed effect removed, z-scored with D_P statistics) and, for the morpheus_factorized arm, its representation coordinates mapped back to genes by response-free observed-coordinate links

always: the 41 Gavish program scores of the spot
when_order_ge_3: all pairwise products of the candidate's variables
competitor_set.rule: the simpler model is fit on D_P and frozen; gain = R2(simpler + candidate feature, D_R) - R2(simpler, D_R)
competitor_set.exclusion_clause: the simpler model never contains the response or a deterministic function of it: for cv_frac_<class> targets all CellViT class fractions are excluded from the baseline (they sum to one); for nbr_mp<k> targets the target program's own neighbour mean is excluded (the other 40 neighbour-mean programs and the spot's own 41 program scores remain); receipts record the baseline column names
competitor_set.centring_rule: every competitor column is within-patient STANDARDISED (within sample for spatial contexts): minus the within-patient mean, divided by the within-patient sd of that column's own values (floored), exactly as the response is; the competitor is fit on D_P and frozen; implemented in the substrate (hest.real_episode / bmmc.real_episode, within_patient_scale=True), recorded as metadata.baseline_standardised. Reason: the v0.3 competitor was uncentred (did not transfer); a centred-only competitor still failed morph_pc1 on fold 0 (held-out R2 -0.28 to -0.51) because the within-patient spread of the response differed 3.4x across held-out patients.
competitor_set.library: validation: ridge on the standardised competitor columns with regularisation chosen by patient-grouped inner cross-validation on D_P over a fixed alpha grid that includes the zero (fold-mean) model; the full model (competitor + hypothesis feature) is selected the same way, independently; chosen alphas and both held-out R2 values recorded per row. The generator's conventional-explanation step uses ridge / spline-GAM / gradient boosting chosen on inner patient folds (never on D_R). A fold where the competitor itself is below zero on held-out patients is a fold where a hypothesis must still clear full-model R2 > 0; no other rule.

null_suite.spatial_block: within-patient 2D block swap (6x6 grid) of the response on D_R (destroys spatial organisation, keeps marginals)
null_suite.within_patient_perm: permutation of the response within patient on D_R
null_suite.interaction_break: for |S| >= 2, within-patient block swap of one constituent variable on D_R (breaks joint structure, keeps marginals)

advance_rule.proposed: per relationship family: top 50 hypotheses by mean held-out gain over folds in which they PASSED (held-out full-model R2 > 0 and gain bootstrap CI > 0), ranked across proposers jointly; provenance kept
advance_rule.internal: passing (R2 > 0, gain CI > 0, all applicable structured nulls p <= 0.05) in >= 3 of 5 folds, mean gain >= 0.01 (minimum Level-A effect), BH q <= 0.10 within family; 'recurrence' counts passing folds only
advance_rule.external: CPTAC ccRCC tumours only (n=110, canonical protein isoforms, dedupe_symbols): bulk-RNA transfer of the frozen feature vs the programme analogue or slide H&E descriptors; scale extension, same sign, permutation p <= 0.05
advance_rule.orthogonal: CPTAC proteomics transfer, same sign, p <= 0.05
advance_rule.actionable: pre-registered survival spec (hashed before fitting; CPTAC OS, TCGA-KIRC OS; Cox on tertiles with age/sex/stage[/grade]), translational evidence record (Open Targets, DepMap, drugs, safety, biomarker stage), EIG-ranked discriminating experiment
advance_rule.explanation_level: every internal candidate is decomposed (decompose_explanation): A simple / B additive / C non-additive / D context-dependent; no candidate is dropped for being Level A; E/F only from external evidence flags
advance_rule.passing_fold: a fold passes for a hypothesis only if its held-out full-model R2 > 0 and the gain bootstrap CI lower bound > 0; this is the runner's `validated` rule under v0.4; nulls, mean gain >= min_gain and BH q are applied at pooling

stop_rules: a family with no internal candidate at budget 50: every hypothesis logged with stop_reason and proposer; report honestly; the advance rule never changes post hoc
all survivors labelled known by the novelty tool after reading the hits: report as independent replication; no novelty claim
sign reversal on any external transfer: candidate stops at internal; hash stays locked

proposers.enumeration: single bank variables and low-order products from the raw_genes view (the v0.3 proposer, unchanged)
proposers.residual_generator: cross-fitted conventional-explanation residual -> sparse-gated multimodal residual interaction network (+ graph branch for spatial) -> stability-distilled 1-5 variable hypotheses over the bank views; provenance and search cost recorded per hypothesis; graph branch enabled only for the molecular_x_context_to_tissue_phenotype family
proposers.rule: both run on the proposal patients under ONE shared per-target proposal budget (max_candidates), ranked jointly by patient-grouped cross-validated proposal gain on proposal rows; every hypothesis records its proposer; none is privileged; generator hypotheses that recurred in fewer than half the seed fits are still sent to held-out validation and carry recurrent_in_generator=false (validation is the test, not the stability filter)

measurement_bank.response_free_exclusions: per target, as implemented in measurement_bank.build_bank: morph_pc* drop the hoptimus view; cv_count/cv_area drop the matching nuclear column; cv_frac_* drop all class fractions and entropy; nbr_mp* drop that programme's neighbour mean
measurement_bank.caveat: scimilarity and scgpt are pseudo-bulk spot embeddings on Visium; recorded in every view

molecular_x_context_to_tissue_phenotype.requirement: every hypothesis carries at least one context variable from context_neighbour_mean or cellvit_structure and at least one molecular variable
molecular_x_context_to_tissue_phenotype.generator_note: the generator's structures that are context-only or molecular-only do not satisfy this family's requirement and are not frozen here; their counts are kept in proposer_report (fold-0 smoke: 0 emitted with the graph on)

composition_adjacency_to_molecular.exclusion: the target programme and its neighbour mean are excluded from candidates and competitor
composition_adjacency_to_molecular.target_definition: own_mp{k}: own-spot Gavish programme score of the k-th highest within-patient Moran's I programme ranked on proposal patients (same ranking as nbr_mp), within-patient centred
composition_adjacency_to_molecular.competitor_note: depth, CellViT class fractions and the other programme scores; the target programme and its neighbour mean are excluded everywhere

tissue_to_patient.status: deferred to the external stage: CPTAC slide descriptors and outcomes, after candidates are frozen

discovery.rows: every v0.4 episode is coverage-complete: spots with H-Optimus-0, CellViT geometry and tissue structure all present; the kept fraction is recorded per fold and target; nothing is imputed
discovery.response_transform: every response is within-patient standardised (mean 0, sd 1 per patient on its own values); recorded as metadata.response_standardised
